clue.text: Plant was promoted on TV

indicators.note: on here means placed after, so the promotion word follows the television word

parts.note: the tube is informal for television
rose means went up in rank, was promoted

explanation.surface: A gardener's specimen got a big push on a television programme.
explanation.definitionFit: The tuberose is a fragrant flowering plant grown from a bulb-like tuber.

clue.text: Salts forming deposit on teeth

parts.note: a salt is an old sailor, as is a tar; two of them give two tars
a salt is an old sailor, as is a tar; two of them give two tars

explanation.surface: Chemical salts are what build up as a crust on your teeth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Salts' looks chemical, but it is plural sailors: two TARs side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Tartar is the hard calcified crust that dentists scrape from teeth.

clue.text: Sweet smell from person in European city

indicators.note: in puts the smell inside the name of the city

parts.note: Bonn is a city in Germany, once its capital
BO is body odour, the smell a person gives off

explanation.surface: A pleasant scent wafts from someone living in a European city.
explanation.definitionFit: A bonbon is a small confection, a sweet.

clue.text: Element rather unusually found around piece of land

indicators.note: around says the rearranged letters wrap the piece of land
unusually says the letters of rather are set out in an odd order

parts.note: an are is a metric unit of land area, 100 square metres

explanation.surface: Some element is said to occur, oddly enough, around a particular plot of land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusually' signals the anagram and 'around' the container; an are is a metric land measure of 100 square metres, rare outside crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Rare earths are a group of metallic chemical elements, the lanthanides.

clue.text: Lunatic craves celery when moon is blue

indicators.note: lunatic means crazy, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A madman longs for celery whenever the moon turns blue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lunatic' fits the moon picture but signals the anagram of CRAVES CELERY.
explanation.definitionFit: Once in a blue moon is an idiom for very rarely, almost never.

clue.text: Engraved boys' names, in short

parts.note: Chas is short for Charles and Ed for Edward
Chas is short for Charles and Ed for Edward

explanation.surface: Boys' names were cut into something, abbreviated.
explanation.definitionFit: To chase metal is to engrave or emboss it, so chased means engraved.

clue.text: Organ transplant hard in part of 3

indicators.note: transplant says the hard letter is moved to a new spot in the word

parts.note: 3 down is RARE EARTH, and its second word is a part of it
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: An organ transplant proves difficult in one part of the operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transplant' moves the H of EARTH to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: The heart is the muscular organ that pumps blood.

clue.text: Musical performance contributing to blessings on godchild

indicators.note: contributing to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Music at a christening adds to the blessings heaped on the baby.
explanation.definitionFit: A singsong is an informal session of group singing.

clue.text: Violent exchange, or what periodically interrupts it?

definitions.meaning: a heated row or slugging match
the bell that sounds between rounds of a boxing bout

explanation.definitionFit: A ding-dong is a fierce argument or fight, and the word also imitates a ringing bell.

clue.text: Clear damaged organ internally in heart bypass?

indicators.note: internally says the rearranged letters go inside the word for clear

parts.note: to rid a place is to clear it

indicators.note: damaged says the letters of organ are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: A surgeon clears a damaged organ from inside during heart bypass surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' rearranges ORGAN inside the word for clear. The surgery picture misleads: the heart here is a town centre that traffic bypasses.
explanation.definitionFit: A ring road lets traffic bypass the centre, or heart, of a town.

clue.text: Gun shot during break

definitions.meaning: in billiards, a stroke where the cue ball strikes two others, made during a scoring run called a break

explanation.definitionFit: A cannon is both an old artillery gun and a billiards shot hitting two balls in turn.

clue.text: Deride school with a grunt when put in another form

indicators.note: putting the letters into another form means rearranging them

explanation.surface: Mocking a school, someone grunts when moved into a different class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put in another form' rearranges SCHOOL, A and GRUNT; 'form' teasingly suggests a school class.
explanation.definitionFit: To laugh to scorn is an idiom meaning to ridicule or mock.

clue.text: Agreeing to make reparations

definitions.meaning: being of one mind, in harmony
to make amends for a wrong

explanation.definitionFit: Atone means make amends, and split as at one it means in agreement.

clue.text: Held back by 5, it's beaten

indicators.note: held back by means kept inside, so the contraction sits within the other answer

parts.note: 5 across is CHASED
'tis is the poetic contraction of it is

explanation.surface: Something restrained by an engraving gets battered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Held back by' just means contained by. 'Tis is an archaic poetic form of it is, common in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Chastised means punished, which can include being physically beaten.

clue.text: Introduction of expert cricket side's to sign on

parts.note: a pro is a professional, an expert
the leg side is one half of a cricket field
an omen is a sign of things to come
taken as written

explanation.surface: An introduction for a skilled cricket team set to sign up.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the field is split into the leg (or on) side and the off side.
explanation.definitionFit: A prolegomenon is a formal preface or introductory essay to a book.

clue.text: Preserve weapon a boy found in Eastern state

indicators.note: found in says the other pieces sit inside the state's abbreviation

parts.note: ME is the abbreviation for Maine, a US state on the East Coast
an arm is a weapon
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A weapon and a boy are discovered in some eastern state.
explanation.definitionFit: Marmalade is a citrus fruit preserve, a jam made from oranges.

clue.text: Game between opponents at opposite ends of the table

definitions.text: Game between opponents at opposite ends of the table

parts.words: Game between opponents at opposite ends of the table
parts.note: a sport for two players facing each other across a table, the ball going back and forth with alternating sounds

explanation.definitionFit: Ping-pong is table tennis, played by opponents at each end of a table.

clue.text: Greek in family circle no good for epic

indicators.note: in puts the Greek abbreviation inside the run of other pieces

parts.note: kin are family
O is shaped like a circle

explanation.surface: A Greek within a family circle proves useless for an epic poem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'epic' suggests Homer, but here it is a big film.
explanation.definitionFit: King Kong is a famous epic monster film from 1933.

clue.text: Brendan and his like are such dogs

definitions.text: Brendan and his like are such dogs

parts.words: Brendan and his like are such dogs
parts.note: Brendan is the setter of this puzzle and Irish, so he and his fellows are compilers from Ireland, which is also a breed of red gundog

explanation.definitionFit: Irish setters are a red-coated gundog breed; a setter is also a crossword compiler.

clue.text: Drum putting bird up

indicators.note: up in a down clue says the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the motmot is a colourful tropical American bird

explanation.surface: Someone beats a drum while keeping a bird elevated.
explanation.definitionFit: A tom-tom is a hand-beaten drum.

clue.text: Is able to preserve old dance

parts.note: can means is able
to can food is to preserve it in tins

explanation.surface: Someone is capable of keeping an old dance alive.
explanation.definitionFit: The cancan is a high-kicking dance from nineteenth-century Paris music halls.

clue.text: Fetchingly enterprising types?

parts.note: ambitious people, read whimsically as ones who go and fetch things

explanation.definitionFit: Go-getters are energetic ambitious people; to go and get is to fetch.

clue.text: Altered state, in a sense

indicators.note: altered says the letters of state are changed in order

explanation.surface: An altered state of consciousness is felt in a certain way.
explanation.definitionFit: Taste is one of the five senses.

clue.text: Public space, circle in site of mausoleum

indicators.note: in puts the circle inside the city

parts.note: Agra in India is where the Taj Mahal mausoleum stands
O is shaped like a circle

explanation.surface: A public square encircled at the location of a famous tomb.
explanation.definitionFit: An agora was the open public square of an ancient Greek city.

clue.text: Player is cramped by faulty boot

indicators.note: cramped by says the word is squeezed inside the rearranged letters
faulty says the letters of boot are put wrong

explanation.surface: A footballer is hampered by a defective boot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faulty' makes OBOT, and IS goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An oboist is a musician who plays the oboe.

clue.text: Like metal company found by sea

parts.note: the Baltic is a sea in northern Europe

explanation.surface: A metal-trading firm is based beside the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Cobaltic means relating to or containing cobalt, a metal.

clue.text: Choked, so unable to speak

definitions.meaning: silenced with something over the mouth

explanation.definitionFit: Gagged means both retched as if choking and silenced by a mouth covering.

clue.text: Fashionable style — with parts switched, mind

parts.note: in means fashionable

indicators.note: with parts switched says the two halves of the word trade places

parts.note: manner means style or way

explanation.surface: A trendy look, rearranged, makes one think.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with parts switched' turns MANNER into NERMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: The inner man means a person's mind or soul.
